about_the_game:
Face off against other players in MIXCITY SWAP, an online card game that’s easy to pick up but packed with strategic depth! Here, every sport collides—from soccer and boxing to padel and even chess boxing.

But MIXCITY SWAP is more than just a game. It’s a world where everyone can find their place, no matter their background, playstyle, or personal flair. Because both sports and games are meant to bring people together!

Our goal? To create a competitive, fun, and accessible game that stays true to our studio’s DNA—innovative, strategy-driven, and always full of surprises. So, are you ready to step into the arena?

Build the ultimate team in a fast-paced, strategic card game where all sports clash!

All you need is 13 minutes, a few cards, and a sharp mind to jump into the game Mixcity Swap! Available for free on PC and Smartphone, it takes only a few minutes to learn but offers countless hours of depth and exploration.

Assemble a team of 9 athletes and face off against your rivals in a futuristic world. Expect card collecting, crafting teams with powerful synergies, and epic strategic showdowns.

Whether you’re here to casually experiment with unique team setups or to discover powerful combos to reach the top step of the podium, you’ll find a game mode that suits you. Want to collect the most stunning cards and cosmetics and compete against friends? Then jump in and be part of the Mixcity Swap experience!

Health and strength points? That’s familiar territory. But a deck without drawing mechanics and card effects that trigger when they move on the field? That’s something new! In our game, swapping cards between your hand and the field, the “Swap”, is the driving force behind the gameplay.

Card positioning is key to your strategy. How will you protect your best attacker? By placing it behind a tough, resilient card! Is one of your cards about to get knocked out? Use the Swap to return it to your hand. This opens up opportunities to trigger powerful effects and outmaneuver your opponent’s cards. The first to score 5 KOs wins the match, so play smart and outwit your opponent!

Mixcity is a universe where athletes from all disciplines clash using futuristic gear. Want to see a tennis player with supersonic serves go up against a basketball player with explosive shots? You’ve come to the right place!

But why include adaptive sports in a world where such advanced prosthetics exist? To us, Mixcity is more than just a setting; it’s a statement. Mixcity celebrates the blending of different genders, backgrounds, abilities, and appearances. We’re committed to using our game to promote values of inclusivity and empathy.

If this world speaks to you, we’re also developing a MOBA where you can play as your favorite characters: Mixcity Arena.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel core i3-14100
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 650 / Radeon 4800 HS
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel core i5-12400 / Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 970 / Radeon 6500
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: MIXCITY SWAP is a fresh and dynamic card game set in a futuristic world where athletes from all sports compete for the crowd’s excitement. Build your team by selecting 9 unique athletes and be the first to score 5 KOs to win the match!

English*, French, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Portugal
*languages with full audio support
